body_lead: Artificial intelligence (AI)-powered education and upskilling infrastructure provider ConveGenius.AI has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Department of Information Technology, government of Bihar, to build Bihar’s Atmanirbhar AI infrastructure – marking a key step in India’s sovereign AI journey. Under this partnership, Bihar’s AI stack will be built and governed within the state. The Government of Bihar will retain control over its data and AI governance, with strong transparency and guardrails.
